text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Class is right about to start, Zephyr. Is
everything
okay? It's not like you to be
running late.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The lock on the bathroom door broke... I
couldn't
get out...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Trapped inside, the wind couldn't reach
me... and
the air grew thick...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr is left exhausted after
her
bathroom ordeal.
